parameters.label: Sort
parameters.name: sortmethod
parameters.description: ⊞  - Determines how the table will be sorted.

parameters.label: Rows (Specify Column Name)
parameters.name: colname
parameters.description: Sort rows using the column specified under the  Name  parameter.

parameters.label: Rows (Specify Column Index)
parameters.name: colindex
parameters.description: Sort rows using the column specified under the  Index  parameter.

parameters.label: Rows (Preserve Input Order)
parameters.name: colpreserve
parameters.description: Uses the current ordering of the input. This sorting allows parameters such as Preserve First, Unique Output, and Reverse Output to be applied to the original input.

parameters.label: Columns (Specify Row Name)
parameters.name: rowname
parameters.description: Sort columns using the row specified under the  Name  parameter.

parameters.label: Columns (Specify Row Index)
parameters.name: rowindex
parameters.description: Sort columns using the row specified under the  Index  parameter.

parameters.label: Columns (Preserve Input Order)
parameters.name: rowpreserve
parameters.description: Uses the current ordering of the input. This sorting allows parameters such as Preserve First, Unique Output, and Reverse Output to be applied to the original input.

parameters.label: Name
parameters.name: name
parameters.description: When using  Sort   Specify Row/Column Name , specify the name in this parameter. If the sort name does not find a match, the output will be unsorted.

parameters.label: Index
parameters.name: index
parameters.description: When using  Sort   Specify Row/Column Index , specify the index in this parameter. If the sort index is -1 or out of bounds, the output will be unsorted.

parameters.label: Order
parameters.name: order
parameters.description: ⊞  - Determines the type of sorting.

parameters.label: Alphabetical
parameters.name: alpha
parameters.description: Use alphabetical sorting. Numbers are treated as characters, sorted by their ASCII values.

parameters.label: Alphabetical with Numbers
parameters.name: alphanum
parameters.description: Use alphanumerical sorting.

parameters.label: Numbers
parameters.name: nums
parameters.description: Use numerical sorting. Characters are all treated as 0, incoming order is preserved.

parameters.label: Random
parameters.name: random
parameters.description: Randomly sorts the table, uses random  Seed  parameter below.

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: The random seed when  Sort Order  is set to  Random .

parameters.label: Ignore Case
parameters.name: ignorecase
parameters.description: Ignores case sensitivity when Sort Order is set to Alphabetical or Alphabetical with Numbers.

parameters.label: Preserve First
parameters.name: preservefirst
parameters.description: Does not resort the first row or column (depending if  Sort  is set to Rows or Columns).

parameters.label: Unique Output
parameters.name: unique
parameters.description: ⊞  - Remove duplicate rows/column entries in the sorted row/column.

parameters.label: Reverse Output
parameters.name: reverse
parameters.description: Reverses the sort order.

parameters.label: Language
parameters.name: language
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select how the  DAT  decides which script language to operate on.

parameters.label: Input
parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The  DAT  uses the inputs script language.

parameters.label: Node
parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The  DAT  uses it's own script language.

parameters.label: Edit/View Extension
parameters.name: extension
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select the file extension this  DAT  should expose to external editors.

parameters.label: dat
parameters.name: dat
parameters.description: various common file extensions.

parameters.label: From Language
parameters.name: languageext
parameters.description: pick extension from DATs script language.

parameters.label: Custom Extension
parameters.name: customext
parameters.description: Specify a custom extension.

parameters.label: Custom Extension
parameters.name: customext
parameters.description: Specifiy the custom extension.

parameters.label: Word Wrap
parameters.name: wordwrap
parameters.description: ⊞  - Enable Word Wrap for Node Display.

parameters.label: Input
parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The  DAT  uses the inputs setting.

parameters.label: On
parameters.name: on
parameters.description: Turn on Word Wrap.

parameters.label: Off
parameters.name: off
parameters.description: Turn off Word Wrap.

parameters.label: num_rows
parameters.description: Number of rows in this  DAT .

parameters.label: num_cols
parameters.description: Number of columns in this  DAT .

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.
